tabs.tab_title: What does an SEO, AEO and GEO strategist in Bangladesh actually do?
tabs.tab_content: I improve how visible your business is across every search surface, not just Google. That means technical SEO, semantic SEO, AEO and GEO together — so you rank in traditional results and get cited inside AI-generated answers on ChatGPT, Perplexity and AI Overviews.

tabs.tab_title: How does SEO differ from AEO and GEO?
tabs.tab_content: SEO improves rankings within search results. AEO helps your content appear in featured snippets and AI summaries. GEO increases visibility and citations inside AI-generated responses from platforms like ChatGPT and Perplexity. Most Bangladeshi businesses are doing the first and ignoring the other two.

tabs.tab_title: Can a Bangladeshi business appear in Google AI Overviews?
tabs.tab_content: Yes. It depends on authoritative content, clean structured data, entity recognition and demonstrated first-hand knowledge of your industry — not on where the business is registered.

tabs.tab_title: What is Entity SEO and why does it matter?
tabs.tab_content: Entity SEO helps search engines understand real-world entities and how they relate. Modern search and AI systems rely on entities for context, which strengthens your presence in the Knowledge Graph and makes your brand easier to cite correctly.

tabs.tab_title: How long does SEO take to show results in Bangladesh?
tabs.tab_content: SEO is a long-term investment anywhere. Most businesses see measurable improvement within three to six months, though competitive niches take longer. Local map-pack work often moves faster than national organic rankings.

tabs.tab_title: Which industries do you work with?
tabs.tab_content: More than 70 so far — restaurants, SaaS, e-commerce, healthcare, real estate and professional services — each with a strategy built for that market rather than a template.

tabs.tab_title: Do you handle development as well as strategy?
tabs.tab_content: Yes. I build and optimise WordPress and Shopify sites, develop custom plugins and set up AI automations, so the SEO strategy and the implementation never drift apart.
